# Q-050 E22: 100.00 USD bought into Assets:USD Savings, then 2,720.00 USD
# arriving in Assets:Wise USD, a 0.72 USD fee out of Wise and a 5.00 USD fee
# out of Savings, in one transaction, neither fee giving a cost basis.
#
# One US dollar account rising while another falls is refused as a transfer
# sharing a transaction before anything asks which cost basis a spend gives:
# nothing in it says whether the 5.00 left the book or moved into Wise. So it
# is written as separate transactions, and the refusal offers no arrival net of
# a fee. (Out of an empty Savings the 5.00 would be a borrowing, not a spend.)
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_split_draws_on_a_cost_basis_by_its_position_in_the_file.py.
2026-08-01 * "Dollars bought into savings"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD Savings 100.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "140.00"
	Assets:Chequing -140.00 CAD

2026-08-13 * "Received money, less a fee from each of two accounts"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Wise USD 2720.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "380000/272000"
		value: "3800.00"
	Assets:Wise USD -0.72 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "101/72"
		value: "-1.01"
	Assets:USD Savings -5.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "7/5"
		value: "-7.00"
	Income:Sales -3800.00 CAD
	Expenses:Bank charges 8.01 CAD
